title: HF459 (2021-2022 Regular): School staff that are permitted and trained allowed to carry firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2021-01-28; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/0/HF/459/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version, 2021-01-28. Section 2 also strikes the word 'or' and a period to fit new clause (10). The school permit lasts one year and needs completion of the training within the prior year.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 299C.26): (a) The superintendent of the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension, in consultation with security and law enforcement experts with appropriate qualifications and experience in responding to active shooter situations, must establish a school and postsecondary institution teacher and employee firearm training program that includes at a minimum training in active shooter situations.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d): (10) teachers and employees of public elementary, middle, and secondary schools; charter schools under chapter 124E; and postsecondary institutions under chapter 136F or 137 who have a school permit to carry under section 624.714, subdivision 8b.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d): (g) Notwithstanding section 471.634, a school district or other entity composed exclusively of school districts may not regulate firearms, ammunition, or their respective components, when possessed or carried by nonstudents or nonemployees, in a manner that is inconsistent with this subdivision.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 8b): (b) Unless a sheriff denies a permit under the exception in subdivision 6, paragraph (a), clause (3), a sheriff must issue a school permit to carry to an applicant if, at the time of submitting an application to the sheriff, the applicant:
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): (d) This subdivision does not apply to teachers and employees authorized to carry firearms under section 609.66, subdivision 1d, paragraph (f).
